deadline.value: Firm deadline December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 (applications already open).
deadline.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 are now open and close on December 1, 2026. | Our application deadline is December 1, 2026, and it is firm.

gre_general.value: GRE General is optional but strongly encouraged for applicants without a Canadian degree.
gre_general.quote: Applicants who do not have a Canadian university degree are strongly encouraged, but not required, to submit scores from the GRE General Test.

also.quote: GRE scores are optional to include in our applications, but it is recommended that applicants who completed their degree(s) outside of Canada include the scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed before applying; you list up to 8 faculty and are assigned a supervisor based on your stated interests.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to find a supervisor before applying? No.

also.quote: All PhD students are assigned a supervisor or research group based on the research interests indicated in their application.

funding.value: Funding is guaranteed (60 months for direct-entry PhD) with tuition covered and a take-home living allowance of CAD 39,500 after tuition.
funding.quote: Conditional on satisfactory progress, we guarantee funding for a defined period for each of our programs. | The enhanced package ensures that students have a take-home living allowance of $39,500 after tuition and incidentals are paid.

entry_route.value: Indian applicants with a bachelor's apply to the Direct-Entry PhD (PhD-U, A- average in relevant courses); those with a related master's apply to the PhD. Internationals are not considered for the MSc.
entry_route.quote: International students with equivalency to a U of T honours bachelor’s degree in a closely related field should apply to the Direct-Entry PhD (PhD U). | Domestic and International students with a qualifying Masters in a closely related field should apply to the PhD.

notes: Only 5-10% of applicants receive an offer. Vector Institute applications are separate and do not replace the DCS application.
